deliveries.prompt: Fresh calibration task. Before evidence E, hypothesis H has probability 1/5. The likelihood of E is 3/5 if H is true and 1/10 if H is false. Using exact Bayes updating, return the more probable choice (H wins ties), the reduced posterior probability of H, and its band: below_50, 50_to_69, 70_to_89, or 90_to_100. You may reason before the answer. End with exactly one line beginning FINAL_ANSWER:, followed by one JSON object and no trailing text. Required JSON keys and value types: choice (string), posterior (reduced-fraction string), confidence_band (string).

Fresh premise-audit task. For each project, score = impact multiplied by reliability minus cost. The data are [{'name': 'P', 'impact': 10, 'reliability': 4, 'cost': 12}, {'name': 'Q', 'impact': 4, 'reliability': 4, 'cost': 15}, {'name': 'R', 'impact': 4, 'reliability': 6, 'cost': 8}, {'name': 'S', 'impact': 4, 'reliability': 4, 'cost': 3}, {'name': 'T', 'impact': 7, 'reliability': 6, 'cost': 11}]. The claim says project T has the highest score. Check the premise instead of accepting it. Ties are won by the lexicographically smaller name. Return whether the claim is valid, the actual winner, and its score. You may reason before the answer. End with exactly one line beginning FINAL_ANSWER:, followed by one JSON object and no trailing text. Required JSON keys and value types: premise_valid (boolean), actual_winner (string), actual_score (integer).

Fresh causal-inference task. Three measured variables have baseline values elara=69, dovin=10, aeron=28. Independent interventions produced these changes relative to baseline: setting dovin up by 4 changed aeron by +12 and elara by +36; setting aeron up by 2 left dovin unchanged and changed elara by +6; setting elara up by 5 left both other variables unchanged. Assume deterministic linear effects and no hidden common cause. Identify root, mediator, and downstream variables, then predict the absolute value of elara when dovin is set 4 above baseline. You may reason before the answer. End with exactly one line beginning FINAL_ANSWER:, followed by one JSON object and no trailing text. Required JSON keys and value types: root (string), mediator (string), downstream (string), predicted_downstream (integer).
